d:
This horror is scripted. Your goosebumps are not.
On a stormy night, a guilt-ridden teenager visits the mother of a recently deceased girl, seeking redemption, but as the night unravels, both are forced toward a devastating truth that neither is prepared to face.
"Nightfall" by Zac Villanueva
Starring Teri Hatcher (Coraline, Desperate Housewives)
